policy: one completed short-lived spare, only after actual demand; ready Snell pool remains first choice

observed_counterexamples.pool-ready race: Cancelling new dials keeps a single connection cycling through a delayed EOF and adds recurring waits.
observed_counterexamples.pending-preparation race: Stealing a completing spare from the next request and restarting preparation increases dial attempts and regresses the staggered workload.
observed_counterexamples.adaptive gating: Avoids an unused spare for purely sequential requests but misses the useful beginning of a burst.

limits: Constructed workloads do not establish their real app frequency.
One spare helps one ready hit, not every member of an instantaneous burst.
First ever connection and misses still perform ordinary TCP handshakes.
implementation_in_this_branch: Rejected experimental alternatives retained for reproducibility; not the Android candidate source.
